user.title: Anova Precision Oven
user.description: How do you sign in to the Anova app?

menu_options.paste: Advanced: paste a login key (Google, Apple or Facebook sign-in)

login.title: Sign in to Anova
login.description: Your password is used once to get a login key and is never saved.

data_description.api_key: Jelly Anova reads this public key from Anova's website. It could not be found this time, so paste it here if you have it.

paste.title: Paste a login key
paste.description: For accounts that sign in with Google, Apple or Facebook. Paste the refresh token from your Anova web session.

data_description.api_key: Jelly Anova reads this public key from Anova's website. It could not be found this time, so paste it here if you have it.

personal.title: Personal token (optional)
personal.description: Optional. The personal token from the Anova app is the backup for Stop: it is used to stop the oven if the normal login stops working. You can leave this empty.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Anova again
reauth_confirm.description: Anova no longer accepts the saved login. Enter your email and password again. The password is not saved.

error.invalid_auth: Wrong email or password, or the login key is not valid.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Anova. Try again in a minute.
error.invalid_api_key: Anova did not accept its web key. Paste a current one into the key box, or try again later.
error.no_api_key: The Anova web key could not be found. Paste it into the key box.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Jelly Anova is already set up.

login_failed.title: Anova login stopped working during a cook
login_failed.description: Anova no longer accepts the saved login while the oven may be cooking, so Home Assistant cannot see the oven. Check the oven, then sign in again from the Jelly Anova integration. A saved stop time still goes out, through the personal token if you added one.

stop_failed.title: The oven could not be stopped
stop_failed.description: Home Assistant tried to stop the oven at the end of a cook and could not reach it. The oven may still be heating, so please check it now. Home Assistant keeps trying.
